name: digital-bus-pass
description: Personal digital bus pass organiser - web, Android and iOS

scripts.android:run: npm run sync && cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.ios:run: npm run sync && cap run ios
scripts.ios:pods: npm run sync && cd ios/App && pod install
scripts.ios:sim: npm run sync && node scripts/xcode.mjs simulator
scripts.ios:archive: npm run sync && node scripts/xcode.mjs archive
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run build
